Today, a man by the name of Martin Lopez was discovered nailing a document to a church door by the priest within, who yelled that the door was over 200 years old and implored him to stop. The document appears to contain a listing of grievances that Martin had with the Catholic church, although religious officials say that many of the things are 'strange' and 'anachronistic'. "What is an 'Indulgence' (written in Filipino) supposed to be?" one bishop inquired.

The Church declined to press vandalism charges against the man.

Martin Lopez has done other stunts before, claiming to be a 'Street Performance Artist' and 'Historical Reenactor'. Most prominent among his previous stunts was when he placed a podium near the wall of the Intramuros within Manila and gave a speech imploring the government to 'Tear down this wall'. The wall has not been removed.

With the recent case, he has become a meme on the Filipino internet, he appears to have become a symbol of 'Smart Jokes', especially ones that fly over others' heads.

Earlier today, I wrote the following post to begin a project that would research the credibility of journalists and news outlets. Many of you got back to me with great ideas. Showing yet another example of how amazing the internet can be. This subverse was created to continue that conversation, with anyone who wishes to participate!

I think in that particular case we have an immensely rich starting point from which to start. By this I mean the pure volume of cases in this story. Many, if not all, journalists in the field chimed in at one time or another. Sitting here two years later it would be very interesting to see who was telling the truth.

When I was promoting my gaming subverse, my general rule of thumb was to PM a mod from each sub I wanted to promote on and ask first. Even if there are no rules on their sub against promoting, it's just a polite extra effort and doesn't take much to do. Most mods I asked were just fine with cross promotion and were only interested in seeing Voat grow. I'd expect you may have the same response from /v/news, /v/KotakuInAction, and other relevant subs.

As far as generic promotion goes, /v/NewSubverses is the big one to post to. /v/promote and /v/promotesubverses are both smaller, but posting there will also make your post show up in /v/all/new for a time. Also, /v/whatever is a catch-all sub with no content restrictions, so that's a good place to post as well.
